requirements.title: IEEE_MAX_MAG equal magnitudes delegate to IEEE_MAX
requirements.definition: For equal magnitudes, IEEE_MAX_MAG returns the value of IEEE_MAX(X,Y).

pending.IEEE_MAX_MAG-equal-magnitude-delegates-t: Probe D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX_MAG, IEEE_MAX, IEEE_VALUE, IEEE_IS_NAN, and IEEE_CLASS, plus N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0). Branch D true and N true: assert IEEE_MAX_MAG(-2.0,2.0)==IEEE_MAX(-2.0,2.0)==2.0 and repeat reversed; also evaluate IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.5,Q), IEEE_MAX_MAG(Q,1.5), IEEE_MAX_MAG(Q,Q), IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.5,S), IEEE_MAX_MAG(S,1.5), and IEEE_MAX_MAG(S,S), with Q = IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_QUIET_NAN), S = IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), and the nonhalting invalid branch from the exception plan for S rows; assert each NaN-row result satisfies IEEE_IS_NAN(result) and IEEE_CLASS(result)==IEEE_QUIET_NAN; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MAX_MAG-mixed-signed-zero-result-po: Probe D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) for IEEE_MAX_MAG, IEEE_COPY_SIGN, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE. requirements.title: IEEE_MAX_MAG exception signaling rules
requirements.definition: For IEEE_MAX_MAG, a signaling NaN operand signals IEEE_INVALID; otherwise no exception is signaled.

pending.IEEE_MAX_MAG-signaling-nan-signals-inval: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX_MAG and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), F = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID, 1.0) for IEEE_SET_FLAG, IEEE_GET_FLAG, and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, and H = IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) for IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE. Branch D true, N true, F true, H true: set invalid halting false, clear IEEE_INVALID, evaluate IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.0), and assert IEEE_INVALID true; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE reporting h false: clear IEEE_INVALID, evaluate IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.0), and assert IEEE_INVALID true; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with h true: skip; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MAX_MAG-quiet-and-numeric-signal-no: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX_MAG and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), and one F_flag = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag, 1.0) branch for each of IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, and IEEE_INEXACT using IEEE_SET_FLAG and IEEE_GET_FLAG. Branch D true, N true, and current F_flag true: clear that flag, evaluate IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.0,2.0), IEEE_MAX_MAG(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_QUIET_NAN)), and IEEE_MAX_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_QUIET_NAN), 1.0), then assert that flag remains false; unsupported branches are not claimed.

review_rationale: Source registration for 17.11.16-17.11.21: IEEE_LOGB, IEEE_MAX, IEEE_MAX_MAG, IEEE_MAX_NUM, IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG and IEEE_MIN (batch217). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; each MAX/MIN variant is discriminated from its neighbours by a planned row, NaN handling covers quiet and signaling operands, and exception rows are halting-safe.
